results.title: Can I change my EMI due date?
results.content: Yes, once during the loan tenure. Submit the EMI Date Change Request form at least 10 days before the next due date. Available dates are the 2nd, 5th, 10th and 15th. Broken-period interest for the extra days is added to the next EMI.

results.title: Is my EMI amount going to change?
results.content: For fixed-rate loans the EMI stays the same for the full tenure. For floating-rate loans the EMI or tenure may change when the benchmark rate changes; you will be informed in advance.

results.title: What happens if I miss my EMI due date?
results.content: If the EMI is not received within the grace period, a late payment charge of 2% per month on the overdue EMI amount is levied, along with a bounce charge of ₹590 (inclusive of GST) if an auto-debit or cheque fails. Missed payments are reported to credit bureaus such as CIBIL and may lower your credit score.

result.instruction: Answer ONLY from these results, briefly. If they don't answer the question, say you don't have that information.
